alcohol.detail: Accelerated ethanol oxidation creating an early acetaldehyde signal, conferring strong natural protection against heavy drinking.

apoe.detail: One ε4 allele. Carries higher sensitivity to dietary saturated fat, higher average ApoB, and increased lifetime cardiovascular and neurological risk. Highly responsive to zone-2 exercise, omega-3s, and optimal sleep.

autoimmune_hla.detail: Common HLA-B27 and PTPN22 risk tags not detected.

bitter.detail: High sensitivity to glucosinolate bitterness in cruciferous vegetables and black coffee. Cook brassicas with healthy fats, salt, and lemon to neutralize bitterness.

caffeine_sleep.detail: Slow CYP1A2 clearance (caffeine half-life ~8–10 hours). Caffeine strongly fragments slow-wave deep sleep and can trigger palpitations or anxiety. Keep intake minimal (<100mg) and strictly early morning.

connective_tissue.detail: Balanced tendon elasticity and joint mobility.

cyp2c19_trait.detail: Impaired bioactivation of clopidogrel (Plavix) and slowed clearance of escitalopram and omeprazole.

fatty_liver.detail: Impaired hepatic lipid droplet hydrolysis. Liver is highly sensitive to refined sugars, fructose, and alcohol. Prioritize dietary choline (eggs) and omega-3s.

histamine_trait.detail: Standard DAO and HNMT enzyme kinetics.

lactase.detail: The -13910T variant keeps intestinal lactase active in adulthood, allowing efficient milk sugar digestion.

lipid_complex.detail: Standard baseline for circulating lipoproteins and hepatic uptake.

longevity_trait.detail: Carries the major global centenarian longevity factor promoting enhanced autophagy, DNA repair, and stem cell maintenance.

mthfr.detail: Significant drop in 5-MTHF production and heightened vulnerability to elevated homocysteine when dietary folate or riboflavin (B2) is low. Natural food folates (leafy greens, legumes) and riboflavin are primary lifestyle priorities.

muscle_type.detail: Versatile muscle architecture supporting both strength and aerobic conditioning.

neuro_profile.detail: Equilibrated dopamine turnover, neuroplasticity, and baseline stress recovery.

omega3_fads.detail: Normal baseline conversion of plant essential fatty acids.

pigment.detail: Suppressed OCA2 expression in iris stroma. High predictability for blue, gray, or light green eyes. Paired with MC1R sun-sensitivity variant.

vit_a_conversion.detail: Moderately reduced plant carotenoid cleavage. Include dietary preformed vitamin A.

vit_d_axis.detail: Carries DBP or CYP2R1 variants associated with lower baseline circulating 25-OH Vitamin D. Regular sun exposure or D3+K2 supplementation (2,000–4,000 IU) is recommended.
